summary: L03 LN-033 (OD per-item fulfillment route) tested backend + frontend. Backend: original suite 8/8 (after test-isolation fix) + new edge suite 11/11 pass (permissions/can flags per role, 'both' article blocked until route chosen, create-pr requires route, blank-reason deviation 400, idempotent same-route, concurrent route change -> 1x200 + 409s with single history entry, cancelled OD 400, invalid warehouse -> 404 with error saved + lock released + retry OK, needs_data -> switch back to purchase cancels/retires old PR and new purchase PR->PO, fresh lock 409 / stale lock reclaimed, create-pr manual then realize reuses same PR, /procure partial errors + idempotent, 404 unknown OD). Frontend: demo OD SORD-261018-0003 panel verified (item1 realized PO locked, item2 deviation -> reason input required -> save enabled only with reason; reverted; realized item2 -> MKO-00018 shown, status Terealisasi, route locked). Manager on TEST OD: deviation saved with reason shown, 'both' item route chosen -> ready, realize -> needs_data with error + 'Ulangi realisasi', realize item2 -> PO. Sales: read-only (no selects/realize buttons).

minor.issue: realize_all calls realize(check_perm=False) and only catches FulfillmentError; HTTPException (e.g. whs.assert_usable 404/403), PermissionError, or plain ValueError from pr_svc.create_requisition propagate and abort remaining items (and may break lock-price side effect). Also /procure only requires purchase_requisition.create, bypassing od_fulfillment.realize.
Manual create-pr without warehouse_id creates PR with warehouse_id '' (realize path uses default warehouse; create-pr does not).

Input material qty = target output qty * yield with no unit conversion: demo TEST recipe (output kg, grey input yard) produced MKO-00018 input 11 yard -> forecast 1.66 kg vs 11 kg ordered; fulfillment status still 'realized' with no under-forecast warning.

ui_bugs.issue: od-mko-chip is in the else-branch of the PO chip ternary, so mixed OD (PO + MKO, e.g. demo SORD-261018-0003) only shows PO chip; MKO chip never visible.
If initial GET /fulfillment fails, data stays null and component returns null, so od-ful-error message is never rendered.

issues: Demo/test data shows 'supplier pemenang uji Kanda Fabric' while PO partner is PT Benang Sejahtera Abadi (decision.supplier_name mismatches supplier_id sup_c0c3c13dc21a in seeded md_samples) - data cosmetic
needs_data error text has redundant tail ('...dihitung otomatis. — lengkapi resep proses/mitra di master lalu ulangi.')
